name: IdeaKiln

sources.title: IdeaKiln homepage — build-in-public launch platform for makers
Pricing page — free badge route plus paid visibility boosts

conditions: Free submission is possible; the $0 'Badge & Dofollow backlink' option requires adding IdeaKiln's badge to your site and your domain must have DR above 10
All ideas go through a review queue unless a paid 'Queue Skipper' boost ($5) is added
requirements: Indie-maker/build-in-public orientation — ideas can be listed at concept, MVP or launched stage
Badge route: 'Domain rating above 10' and the badge must stay up to keep the dofollow link
Paid boosts: Queue Skipper $5 (published within 2 days), Promoted $19 (dofollow + promoted placement), Premium $29 (landing page + idea page features)
preparation: Idea/product name, tagline, description, category (AI, productivity, marketing, BI, SEO tools etc.)
If taking the badge route: a site location for the IdeaKiln badge and a domain with DR > 10
workflow: Fill in the idea details and stage
Optionally add a boost (badge/dofollow, queue skip, promoted, premium)
Submit into the review queue; track on your dashboard/timeline
Idea appears in 'Today's trending' / weekly / monthly boards after approval
watchFor: The dofollow link on the free route is badge-gated AND gated on your domain having DR > 10 — a genuine DR floor
'Stays dofollow as long as the badge stays up' — removing the badge reverts the link
Free submissions 'still go through the review queue' — no guaranteed timeline published
20%-off boost promotions appear periodically (e.g. SEP20 code seen at retrieval)
countsAsLive: The idea has a public page on ideakiln.com (/ideas/<slug>) and appears in the daily/weekly boards or category listings
unknowns: What the base free listing looks like without the badge (link type unstated)
Submission limits per account ('What's my submission limit?' FAQ entry exists but was collapsed)
